# PR #2016: Patch: split the deploy image's crates stage so a server-only change no longer recompiles the engine, the cards and the AI

Closes #2013

The Dockerfile now has a separate `game` stage for the engine, the cards and the AI, so `db (deploy image crates)` compiles only the server's library on a server-only change. A person still has to edit `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (below) before CI gets any faster. The Dockerfile and `rehearse.sh` changes are in this pull request, but the faster job needs those `ci.yml` edits.

The slow job built the engine, the cards, the AI and the server's library in one stage, so any change under `crates/` recompiled all of it. #1996 changed only `crates/server`. I followed the plan's steps 1–9 as written and departed from it nowhere.

## What changed

- **`crates/server/Dockerfile`**: the new `game` stage copies only `crates/engine`, `crates/cards` and `crates/ai`. It builds the server's library against the server's empty skeleton, then runs `cargo clean -p jackioh-server`. Without the `cargo clean` the build fails with `JACKIOH_RULES_FINGERPRINT not defined`, because the server's copied sources keep older timestamps than the skeleton's build. The `crates` stage is now `FROM game` and copies only `crates/server`. The `planner` stage still copies all of `crates/`, and the header comment now describes six stages.
- **`crates/server/tests/deploy/rehearse.sh`**: `REHEARSAL_STAGE=game` is accepted, in both `case` lists, the FAIL message and the header comments. The build block already passes `--target "$STAGE"`, so it needed no change.
- **`apps/web/src/net/deploy-rehearsal.test.ts`**: two new tests (the `game` stage builds through the cache and starts nothing, and an image flag with `game` is refused before any docker call). The unknown-stage refusal test has the new message. The Dockerfile-order test now pins the stage order, the `cargo clean` line, the exact `COPY` lines of `game` (engine, cards, ai) and `crates` (server), no whole-`crates/` copy after the planner, and no `COPY` in `build`.

## Tests run

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/deploy-rehearsal.test.ts`: 11 passed. The `pretest` WASM build ran first.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`: clean.
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/net/deploy-rehearsal.test.ts`: clean.
- `sh -n crates/server/tests/deploy/rehearse.sh`: clean.
- Docker 28.0.4 was available, so I ran the Docker checks:
  - `REHEARSAL_STAGE=game sh crates/server/tests/deploy/rehearse.sh` exited 0.
  - `REHEARSAL_STAGE=crates sh crates/server/tests/deploy/rehearse.sh` exited 0. Its log has `Compiling jackioh-server` and no other `Compiling jackioh-`, because the `game` layer was cached from the run before.
  - `docker build --target build` of this Dockerfile and of `origin/main`'s Dockerfile (saved to a file outside the repo) both succeeded. `sha256sum /jackioh-server` printed `2472c502a2f53dd92289006f6b3f190133de1592db73c70358919b341bfae0fd` for both, so the binary is byte for byte the same.
- I did not run the cargo checks, the fuzz or the e2e specs. The diff touches no Rust source, so I left them to the harness and CI.
- I did not re-run the new tests against the old `rehearse.sh` to see them fail. The plan says they would, and I did not confirm it.
- I could not measure the build times on GitHub's cache service, which is the largest part of the old 7m55s that is not compile time.

## Decisions

- I kept the plan's `cargo clean --release --locked -p jackioh-server` in the `game` stage rather than touching the source timestamps or dropping `--locked`. Step 9's test pins the line.
- I left the `planner` stage's `COPY crates ./crates` alone. It is cheap, and the recipe it writes changes only when a manifest or the lock file does, so `deps` and `game` stay cached.
- I left the old comment in `rehearse.sh` (around line 185) that says "the deps, crates and image jobs shared one scope". It describes #1787's history, and the plan said to change nothing else in that file.

## For a person: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

Apply these after this merges. The new `db-deploy-game` job must land after this pull request, because the old `rehearse.sh` refuses `REHEARSAL_STAGE=game`. Until then the current `db-deploy-crates` builds both stages in one job, about 9 s slower locally than before.

(a) Insert this job between `db-deploy-deps` and `db-deploy-crates`:
```yaml
db-deploy-game:
  name: db (deploy image game)
  needs: [changes, db-deploy-deps]
  if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.full == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.db_deploy == 'true' }}
  runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  timeout-minutes: 15
  steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
    - uses: crazy-max/ghaction-github-runtime@v3
    - name: the image's game stage
      env:
        REHEARSAL_STAGE: game
        REHEARSAL_CACHE_FROM: "type=gha,scope=deploy-rehearsal type=gha,scope=deploy-rehearsal-game"
        REHEARSAL_CACHE_TO: type=gha,mode=max,scope=deploy-rehearsal-game
      run: sh crates/server/tests/deploy/rehearse.sh
```

(b) In `db-deploy-crates`, set `needs: [changes, db-deploy-game]` and:
```yaml
REHEARSAL_CACHE_FROM: "type=gha,scope=deploy-rehearsal type=gha,scope=deploy-rehearsal-game type=gha,scope=deploy-rehearsal-crates"
REHEARSAL_CACHE_TO: type=gha,mode=max,scope=deploy-rehearsal-crates
```

(c) In `db-deploy-image`, set:
```yaml
REHEARSAL_CACHE_FROM: "type=gha,scope=deploy-rehearsal type=gha,scope=deploy-rehearsal-game type=gha,scope=deploy-rehearsal-crates type=gha,scope=deploy-rehearsal-image"
REHEARSAL_CACHE_TO: ${{ (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/staging') && 'type=gha,mode=max,scope=deploy-rehearsal-image' || '' }}
```

(d) In the aggregate `db` job:
- add `db-deploy-game` to `needs`, after `db-deploy-deps`;
- add `GAME: ${{ needs.db-deploy-game.result }}` to its env;
- add `deploy-game=$GAME` to its `echo`;
- add `test "$GAME" = success` after `test "$DEPS" = success`.

(e) In the comment above `db-deploy-deps`, name `db-deploy-game` (the engine, the cards and the AI) between deps and crates. Say that each job writes a scope of its own and reads the earlier stages' scopes (#1787, #2013).

`deploy-rehearsal` stays the deps job's scope, so the cached dependency layer is still found. Branch protection is unchanged, since only `db` is required.

## Look twice

- The new cache layer keys and scopes start empty, so `game` and `crates` compile once more on the first runs after the `ci.yml` change.
- If `db (deploy image crates)` still runs past five minutes after the `ci.yml` change, its step log will show whether the cache import or the export is the cost. The compile itself is under 100 s of it. The next options are `compression=zstd` on the `REHEARSAL_CACHE_TO` values, a registry cache, or moving the per-PR image build to `super.yml`.
- Render and `super.yml`'s full rehearsal build the whole Dockerfile in one plain `docker build`. That is the case the `cargo clean` line guards, and the `--target build` comparison above exercised it.
- A crate the server comes to depend on later will build as an empty skeleton and fail loudly. A new path dependency changes `Cargo.lock`, which turns on the `db_deploy` job, so CI would catch it. The Dockerfile comment tells the next person to add a `COPY` line.

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml:1196`: The comment above `db-deploy-deps` still says db-deploy-crates builds 'the workspace's crates and the server's library'. Step (e) of the proposed `ci.yml` edits covers fixing it, but a person has to do it.
